description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing and displaying tracebacks in PyTorch, including handling dynamically compiled code, formatting tracebacks, and symbolizing tracebacks for better debugging.

classes.name: CapturedTraceback
classes.description: Class for capturing, summarizing, and formatting tracebacks, including C++ and Python traces.

methods.name: report_compile_source_on_error
methods.description: Context manager that catches exceptions, reconstructs tracebacks with source code info, and allows inspection of dynamically compiled code.

methods.name: shorten_filename
methods.description: Shortens file paths by removing common prefixes, especially for torch subdirectories.

methods.name: format_frame
methods.description: Formats a traceback frame summary into a short, single-line string.

methods.name: format_traceback_short
methods.description: Formats the innermost frame of a traceback into a short string.

methods.name: CapturedTraceback
methods.description: Class encapsulating a traceback object with methods for summarization and formatting.

methods.name: _extract_symbolized_tb
methods.description: Converts a symbolized traceback into a StackSummary object for display.
